intro: Thirty-six changes in a single day. Here are ten you'll notice.

1.headline: The agent can now design your chat background
1.say: A built-in skill now generates your chat background.

2.headline: Shared environments get a Delete action
2.say: Shared environments now offer Delete, and it asks you first.

remove.title: Are you sure you want to delete environment 'my-devbox'?
remove.detail: This removes the environment registration and disconnects this client. Files on the machine will not be deleted. The environment may reappear if its owning application registers it again.

3.headline: Remote Environments management, on by default
3.say: Manage Remote Environments is now on by default, in the Sessions menu.

4.headline: In the Agents window, diffs default to cards
4.say: In the Agents window, the multi diff editor now defaults to cards.

params.description: Controls the experimental variant of the multi diff editor.

5.headline: Cancel a connector while it connects
5.say: While a connector connects, its page now offers Cancel.

params.name: Azure Data Explorer
params.description: Run Kusto queries and explore data in Azure Data Explorer.

6.headline: Cloud models show their real context sizes
6.say: In Cloud chats, a model's Details now show its real context sizes.

context.prompt: Summarize the release notes in the docs folder.

7.headline: Reviews of agent edits stay in sync
7.say: Reviews of agent edits now stay in sync with Keep and Undo.

params.title: Reviews of agent edits stay in sync

lines.text: Open diffs follow the agent's later edits.
Keep and Undo take effect before the next file opens.
Restoring a checkpoint keeps your unsaved edits.

8.headline: Pull requests in a chat share one pill
8.say: Pull requests now share one pill; its dropdown lists each one.

context.prompt: Open a pull request for each fix.
context.reply: I opened five pull requests, one per fix.

9.headline: Relative links open from the chat's folder
9.say: Relative links in agent replies now open from the chat's working directory.

params.title: Relative links open from the chat's folder

lines.text: Relative file links open against the chat's working directory, in history too.
URL approvals show the URL before you approve.

10.headline: Steering HydraFusion no longer looks stuck
10.say: And steering a running HydraFusion phase no longer looks stuck.

params.title: Steering HydraFusion no longer looks stuck

lines.text: A steering message takes over the running workflow.
The running phase shows again, and its tool calls keep appearing.
